item.title: Scenario: FireControl Drops the Connection or Freezes Mid-Cut (the Computer Side)
item.description: A cut stops part-way: FireControl freezes, goes blank, says “Machine disconnected” or “Program cancelled”, or throws a Java error. Electrical noise is the usual suspect and has its own page. This page covers the computer, USB, power-saving, and FireControl-install causes, plus a test to tell them apart.
